title: How to Submit to the Righteousness of God
description: In this sermon, the speaker emphasizes the importance of praying for our children, especially those who are unbelievers. He encourages mothers not to grow weary or let go, but to continue praying for their children's salvation. The speaker explains that the Gospel is the power of salvation for everyone who believes, and urges believers to share it often. The sermon also highlights the significance of Jesus' sacrifice and how it manifests God's righteousness, emphasizing the need to submit to Him for salvation.
